title: Mobile app launch on Dec 1
overview: Tom, Priya and David agreed to launch the mobile app on December 1, one week later than planned, so the backend can add caching. An India-only soft launch is the fallback.

topics.heading: Launch readiness
bullets: Design: onboarding done, checkout about 90%. Dark mode colours on the payment page still open.
Backend: payments API ready, but slow above 2,000 users. Caching needs one more week.

topics.heading: Release notes
bullets: Nobody owned them last time and they shipped late. Tom owns them now.

next_steps.text: Add caching and rerun the load test
Send the load test report to the team
Fix dark mode colours on the payment page
Book a checkout review with support
Write release notes and share a draft

decisions: Launch on December 1, with caching in place.
If load testing still fails: soft launch in India only.
